content.title: Nvidia in advanced talks to buy Israel's AI21 Labs for up to $3 billion, report says
content.summary: Nvidia is in advanced talks to buy Israel-based AI startup AI21 Labs for as much as $3 ​billion, the Calcalist financial daily reported on Tuesday.  Nvidia declined to ‌comment, while AI21 was not immediately available to comment.  Nvidia and Alphabet's Google participated in that funding.
